text.title: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable input signals to a conclusion that references a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Do ALL Applies-If conditions hold AND NO Skip-If condition triggers?

branch.question: Is a named single accountable owner present (not 'team' / 'we' / 'us')?
Is the source-of-truth for required inputs reachable and citable?
Are the Prerequisites artefacts present AND cited with evidence — ≥2 genuine alternatives, and a decision store at `docs/adr/` or `.aidocs/decisions/`?

conclusion.verdict: apply the methodology; produce the decision-record artefact and validate it.
pause; gather the missing Prerequisites with cited evidence and create the in-repo decision store before drafting.
defer until source-of-truth is reachable; paraphrased substitutes are worse than skipping.
block; require a single named owner before any further work.
do not apply this methodology in this context; route to the correct one or skip.

text.example: Applies-If holds, Skip-If clear → owner is a named human → inputs reachable and complete → run per r6-in-repo-not-wiki; the artefact passes `validate-architecture-decision-records.py` with exit 0.
